userStories.title: Pure run-graph contracts, constants, and taken-path classifier
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want pure types, constants, and taken-path classification modules, so that graph layout and path routing share a dependency-free mathematical foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/types.ts defining NodeState ('pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'skipped' | 'awaiting'), RouteOutcome ('positive' | 'negative' | 'exhausted'), LayoutEdgeKind ('dependency' | 'conditional' | 'route'), LayoutNode, LayoutEdge, Point, PortSide ('top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'), LayoutRoute, LayoutResult, and LayoutInput.

Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/constants.ts exporting exact constants NODE_WIDTH = 180, NODE_HEIGHT = 80, NODE_SEP = 40, RANK_SEP = 80, SIDE_PORT_THRESHOLD = 135 (NODE_WIDTH * 0.75), and BACK_EDGE_GUTTER = 46.
Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/taken-path.ts implementing isOnPath(state: NodeState | undefined): boolean and isEdgeTaken(targetState: NodeState | undefined): boolean.
isOnPath returns true only for 'running', 'completed', 'failed', and 'awaiting'; returns false for 'pending', 'skipped', and undefined.
isEdgeTaken delegates to isOnPath(targetState) according to the approved target-started rule.
The pure module contains zero imports from react, @xyflow/react, @dagrejs/dagre, @/lib/api, or browser DOM (window/document).
Write unit tests in packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/taken-path.test.ts verifying all NodeState values and passing via ( cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/run-graph/taken-path.test.ts ).
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 1 of plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-room-from-graph-legacy.md:107-205, 303-338. Create types.ts, constants.ts, taken-path.ts, and taken-path.test.ts in packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/. Pure TypeScript only, no any, no external dependencies.

userStories.title: Cycle-safe layered positions
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want a deterministic cycle-safe layered position algorithm, so that complex workflows with retry loops receive stable, readable node coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/positions.ts implementing computePositions(nodeIds: readonly string[], edges: readonly LayoutEdge[]): PositionResult returning positions, layers, and backEdgeIds.
Deduplicate node IDs preserving their first appearance, and ignore edges whose source or target is not in the deduplicated set.
Build adjacency lists in input edge order and detect back edges using DFS (marking self-edges and edges to an active gray ancestor as back edges).
Exclude detected back edges from longest-path layering; assign targetLayer = max(targetLayer, sourceLayer + 1) in topological order.

Perform two complete barycenter sweeps (top-down with predecessors, bottom-up with successors), preserving current positions for nodes without adjacent neighbors and breaking ties with original first-seen index.

Center each layer horizontally within the maximum layer width using NODE_WIDTH + NODE_SEP (220px) horizontal spacing and NODE_HEIGHT + RANK_SEP (160px) vertical spacing, returning top-left coordinates.
Calculation never inspects node states and produces byte-for-byte identical output on repeated calls.

Tests in packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/positions.test.ts cover empty input, single node, duplicate IDs, missing endpoints, fork centering, layer crossings (a->d, b->c reordering), retry loop back edges (start->work->review->work), two-node cycles, and determinism, passing via ( cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/run-graph/positions.test.ts ).
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 2 of plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-room-from-graph-legacy.md:207-240, 340-388. Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/positions.ts and positions.test.ts. Follow the approved barycenter and DFS cycle breaking algorithms.

userStories.title: Cubic routes and public layout function
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want distance-aware cubic edge routing and a public layout function, so that React Flow edges render smooth, collision-free paths for forward and back edges.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/routes.ts implementing buildRoutes(input): LayoutRoute[] generating cubic SVG paths in 'M x y C x y x y x y' format.
Forward edges leave source bottom-center; short edges (span <= 1 layer or horizontal offset <= SIDE_PORT_THRESHOLD) enter target top-center with bend = Math.max(18, (end.y - start.y) * 0.45).

Long forward edges enter target left-center when target is right of source, or right-center when target is left of source, with sourceBend = Math.max(24, (end.y - start.y) * 0.5) and targetBend = Math.max(40, Math.abs(dx) * 0.35).
Non-self back edges leave source left-center, enter target left-center, and route through an outer left-flank lane at min(source.x, target.x) - BACK_EDGE_GUTTER.
Self-edges start at left-center, end at top-center, and route through an upper-left gutter lane.
Set labelPosition appropriately for top-target, side-target, back-edge, and self-edge routes, and preserve kind, label, and outcome from input edges.
Set taken from target state via isOnPath; set backEdge from backEdgeIds; omit routes when either endpoint lacks a position.
Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/layout.ts implementing layout(input: LayoutInput): LayoutResult combining computePositions and buildRoutes.

Create packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/index.ts exporting layout as the only runtime value, along with type exports for NodeState, RouteOutcome, LayoutEdgeKind, LayoutNode, LayoutEdge, Point, PortSide, LayoutRoute, LayoutResult, and LayoutInput.

Tests in routes.test.ts and layout.test.ts cover all routing geometries, label positions, state-independent positions, back routes, and public contracts, passing via ( cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/run-graph/routes.test.ts src/lib/run-graph/layout.test.ts ).
Import audit confirms no imports from react, @xyflow/react, @dagrejs/dagre, @/lib/api, window, or document in packages/web/src/lib/run-graph/.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 3 of plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-room-from-graph-legacy.md:242-281, 390-449. Create routes.ts, routes.test.ts, layout.ts, layout.test.ts, index.ts. Keep public API narrow.

userStories.title: Adapt workflow definitions to shared run-graph input
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want an adapter from DagNode definitions and live execution statuses to LayoutInput, so that the legacy viewer can consume pure layout without coupling to engine schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-run-graph-input.ts exporting buildRunGraphInput and layoutRunGraph.
buildRunGraphInput transforms DagNode[] and liveStatus into RunGraphInput in definition order; the last matching live status wins, and missing status defaults to 'pending'.
The adapter never maps or emits 'awaiting' from WorkflowStepStatus in Story 5.3.
Ordinary depends_on dependencies become dependency edges with id `${dependency}->${node.id}`; when node.when is non-empty, edge kind becomes 'conditional' with label: node.when.

route_loop targets suppress ordinary dependency edges from the route controller; route targets are emitted in reversed ROUTE_LOOP_OUTCOMES order ('exhausted', 'negative', 'positive') with kind: 'route' and label set to outcome.
Target id collisions use `${source}->${target}:${outcome}` for uniqueness.
layoutRunGraph passes the adapter output directly to pure layout().

Tests in build-run-graph-input.test.ts verify node order, live status precedence, conditional edges, route_loop ordering and deduplication, and skipped target classification, passing via ( cd packages/web && bun test src/components/workflows/build-run-graph-input.test.ts src/lib/dag-layout.test.ts ).
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 4 of plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-room-from-graph-legacy.md:283-317, 451-496. Create build-run-graph-input.ts and build-run-graph-input.test.ts. Import ROUTE_LOOP_OUTCOMES, RouteLoopConfig, and DagNode from @/lib/api.

userStories.title: Render shared routes in legacy React Flow viewer
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the legacy DAG viewer to render nodes and edges using shared run-graph routes and styling, so that taken paths, conditions, and retry loops are visually clear without breaking pan/zoom.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/RunGraphRouteEdge.tsx exporting RunGraphRouteEdge component and RunGraphFlowEdge type.
RunGraphRouteEdge renders BaseEdge with route.path, labelX, labelY, label, and markerEnd without recalculating geometry.

Edge stroke styles follow design tokens: untaken edges use var(--border); taken dependency/conditional use var(--accent-bright); taken positive route uses var(--success); taken negative route uses var(--accent); taken exhausted route uses var(--error); back edges and conditional edges use stroke-dasharray (dashed).
Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-workflow-dag-view-model.ts exporting buildWorkflowDagViewModel(input): WorkflowDagViewModel.

buildWorkflowDagViewModel sets node positions from layoutRunGraph, preserves all execution node display fields via resolveExecutionNodeDisplay, sets selected from selectedNodeId, and creates React Flow edges with type: 'runGraphRoute' and animated: true only when target node status is 'running'.

Update packages/web/src/components/workflows/WorkflowDagViewer.tsx to register edgeTypes = { runGraphRoute: RunGraphRouteEdge } at module scope, replace dagNodesToReactFlow with buildWorkflowDagViewModel, and retain fit, pan, zoom, controls, executing chip, and onNodeClick.

Tests in RunGraphRouteEdge.test.tsx and build-workflow-dag-view-model.test.ts pass via ( cd packages/web && bun test src/components/workflows/build-workflow-dag-view-model.test.ts src/components/workflows/RunGraphRouteEdge.test.tsx ).
packages/web type check passes with no any and no React Flow generic mismatches via ( cd packages/web && bun run type-check ).
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Task 5 of plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-room-from-graph-legacy.md:319-366, 498-558. Create RunGraphRouteEdge.tsx, RunGraphRouteEdge.test.tsx, build-workflow-dag-view-model.ts, build-workflow-dag-view-model.test.ts; modify WorkflowDagViewer.tsx.

userStories.title: Share one room between Graph and Logs with unified selection
userStories.description: As an operator, I want clicking a graph node to open the exact same per-type node room as clicking a logs row, so that switching between Graph and Logs preserves node selection and room state.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/resolve-graph-room-row.ts exporting resolveGraphRoomRow(input): LogRow | null.

resolveGraphRoomRow returns null when nodeId is null; prefers the last ordinary { kind: 'node' } row matching nodeId; falls back to the last matching row (e.g. iteration); or synthesizes a pending LogRow from liveStatus or nodeId if no row matches.
Move packages/web/src/components/workflows/LegacyNodeLogs.tsx to LegacyGraphLogsPane.tsx (using git mv) and rename export to LegacyGraphLogsPane.

LegacyGraphLogsPane renders a single ResizablePanelGroup (defaultSizes 60/40); left panel renders renderGraph in 'graph' mode or NodeRunList in 'logs' mode; right panel always renders the single LegacyNodeRoom.
LegacyGraphLogsPane tracks selectedLogRowId; graph node clicks clear selectedLogRowId and resolve canonical row via resolveGraphRoomRow, while logs row clicks preserve iteration-specific row ID.
Switching between Graph and Logs preserves the selected node, room DOM node, and does not re-fetch messages for unchanged selections.

Add pure selector resolveWorkflowExecutionBody to packages/web/src/components/workflows/WorkflowExecution.tsx, returning 'graph-logs-pane' for DAG Graph and Logs views, 'source-control' for Source Control, 'chat' for Chat with parent, and 'sequential' for non-DAG runs.
Update WorkflowExecution.tsx renderBody to use resolveWorkflowExecutionBody, rendering LegacyGraphLogsPane for both Graph and Logs, removing mergedLogsPanel from DAG Graph mode.
Ensure neither Graph nor Logs contains AskHuman cards, empty Ask slots, awaiting status, or waiting-on-you chrome.

Tests in resolve-graph-room-row.test.ts, LegacyGraphLogsPane.test.tsx, and WorkflowExecution.test.tsx pass via ( cd packages/web && bun test src/components/workflows/WorkflowExecution.test.tsx src/components/workflows/resolve-graph-room-row.test.ts && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/LegacyGraphLogsPane.test.tsx ).
